channel.title: GinkgoQ
channel.description: Technical writing on AI systems, domain intelligence, speech AI, RAG, agents, datasets, models, and production AI infrastructure.

item.title: ASHA Hyperparameter Tuning: A Practical Tutorial for Engineers
item.description: A practical guide to the Asynchronous Successive Halving Algorithm for hyperparameter tuning, with rung schedules, promotion logic, worker behavior, failure modes, and production implementation patterns.

item.title: Designing Evaluation Frameworks for Production AI Systems
item.description: How to build AI evaluation frameworks that test routing, retrieval, tool use, grounding, workflow behavior, cost, latency, and production regressions.

item.title: Agentic AI Architecture, Part 1: How to Design Reliable AI Agents
item.description: A practical guide to agentic AI architecture: what AI agents are, where LLMs fit, and how to design reliable agent systems with state, tools, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation.

item.title: Agentic AI Architecture, Part 2: Building Production AI Agent Systems
item.description: A production playbook for agentic AI systems: orchestration patterns, multi-agent design, retrieval repair, observability, evaluation, cost control, and implementation structure.

item.title: Production RAG Architecture Beyond Vector Search
item.description: How to design production retrieval systems with evidence targets, hybrid search, source-fit scoring, context packing, retrieval repair, and grounding checks.

item.title: Why Model Performance Does Not Determine System Reliability
item.description: Benchmarks are useful, but production AI reliability depends on retrieval quality, validation, observability, fallback behavior, and evaluation across the full system.

item.title: Building Reliable Extraction Pipelines for Document Understanding
item.description: A practical guide to designing document AI pipelines with structured extraction, validation, confidence scoring, provenance, human review, and production observability.

item.title: From RAG to Domain Intelligence
item.description: Why retrieval-augmented generation is only the first layer of production AI, and how extraction, validation, provenance, and domain reasoning turn retrieved text into usable intelligence.
